basic_details.job_title: ISI Project linked person (Agricultural & Ecological Research Unit) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Agricultural & Ecological Research Unit of the Indian Statistical Institute (ISI), Kolkata, is inviting applications for one (01) Project linked person, purely on a temporary basis, to work full time in the project titled “Does a crop-pollinator mutualistic network under intercropping promote greater pollinator diversity? - Optimizing yield, pesticide threshold, and community stability through mathematical modelling”. The last date for application submission is 29 November 2026 (Advertisement No. PU/507/ADV/973, issued 13 November 2026).

how_to_apply: The notice page gives the last date for application submission as 29 November 2026. It lists an attachment named “Advertisement - AERU, Kolkata” on the ISI website, and this attachment is not reproduced on the page text. The notice page does not state the mode of application or the address to send it to.
